content.html: Which pair of equations can both be used to calculate the refractive index n of the glass?
content.text: Which pair of equations can both be used to calculate the refractive index n of the glass?

options.label: A
options.html: n = \(\frac{\text{speed of light in air}}{\text{speed of light in glass}}\) , n = \(\frac{\sin p}{\sin q}\)

options.label: B
options.html: n = \(\frac{\text{speed of light in glass}}{\text{speed of light in air}}\) , n = \(\frac{\sin p}{\sin q}\)

options.label: C
options.html: n = \(\frac{\text{speed of light in air}}{\text{speed of light in glass}}\) , n = \(\frac{\sin q}{\sin p}\)

options.label: D
options.html: n = \(\frac{\text{speed of light in glass}}{\text{speed of light in air}}\) , n = \(\frac{\sin q}{\sin p}\)
